# Terminal Theme Studio

> Browser-based terminal color palette editor and theme exporter. Build one theme and export it in 27 formats, including Kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty, Windows Terminal, iTerm2, Ghostty, Konsole, Contour, Bash/Zsh, Fish, and Nushell.

Terminal Theme Studio is a client-side web app: it requires no backend, and everything (theme editing, preview, export) runs and stays on the user's device. There are no user accounts and no server-side processing of theme data.

## Site

- [Terminal Theme Studio](https://terminal-theme-studio.pages.dev/): the app itself — edit a palette, preview it live in a simulated terminal, and download it in any of the 27 supported formats.

## Notes

- The site is a single page; there are no additional articles, docs, or subpages to crawl.
- Analytics are anonymous and cookie-free (self-hosted Umami); no personal data is collected.
